answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 39070 Country: Pakistan Title: My friend's name is SUBHAN BUKHARI and he wants to know if this combination of names is correct/allowed or not Question: My friend's name is SUBHAN BUKHARI and he wants to know if this combination of names is correct/allowed or not and can he continue to use this name? Answer ID: 39070 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1107/930/B=1433) There is no problem in the combination of names. If he wants to change his name then he may replace it with Sahban Bukhari. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
